blocks.title: The fast store of your node
blocks.description: The fifth store of the node’s memory, next to the database, the files, the vectors and the graph. It is meant for the busy actions of applications: likes, views and reactions kept in memory and passed to the database in batches.

blocks.text: Its folder, its passport and its record in the core’s registry arrive with every node.
Every native element except Stripe is on by default, this one too.
The architect turns it off or on with a word or a button, like every element of the node.
The truth stays in the database
The totals belong to the database element, so the fast store keeps no backup of its own.
A timer or a background transfer of this element is built only by the owner’s word, with its cost in memory named first.

head: Part
What it is
rows: What the element is, and the reason it shows when it is turned off
What the node needs to install it

Redis or one that speaks its protocol, chosen on a server by the owner’s word

blocks.text: Built by Fractera for the [Lagrix](https://lagrix.dev) protocol. MIT license, the code is at [github.com/Fractera/fractera-redis-cache-starter](https://github.com/Fractera/fractera-redis-cache-starter); the copy on your node is yours.
